player_prompt.intro:
I yɛ Mastermind.
I bɛ o donni kɔnɔ ye {code_length} tariku ye, kɛɛrɛ kɛrɛɛna 1 ka taa {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
O tɛ weele, i bɛ o kɛnɛɛ o kɔnɔ o tɛ '[2 1 4 5]'.
O kɛnɛɛ kɛrɛɛna, i bɛ o donni feedback kɛrɛɛna bɛɛ kɛɛrɛ aur fini kɛɛrɛ.
Bɛɛ kɛɛrɛ ye kɛɛrɛ kɛrɛɛna o tɛ kɛrɛɛna, wɛlɛ fini kɛɛrɛ ye kɛɛrɛ kɛrɛɛna o tɛ kɛrɛɛna.
I bɛ {max_turns} tɔn o donni kɔnɔ.
